name: Avalanche Sling Staff
body:
Source Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 22
Aura moderate conjuration CL 9th
Slot none; Price 36,320 gp; Weight 3 lbs.
Description
Three times per day, the wielder of this +3 halfling sling staff can launch a stone (not a sling bullet) that explodes in mid-flight to create a stone callAPG effect centered on the target square.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, stone callAPG; Price 18,320 gp
